name: Custom Score
summary: Combines selected algorithms into one encrypted score after normalizing and weighting their results.
description:
### What it does
Combines the results of one or more child algorithms into a single encrypted score.

### How it works
- Each selected algorithm runs independently, and you can add each one only once.
- A user receives a final score only when every selected algorithm has a result for them. A score of `0` still counts as a result.
- Each algorithm's scores are scaled to 0–100 using its observed minimum and maximum. If its minimum and maximum are equal, all its scaled scores are `0`.
- A weight above `0` controls how much each algorithm affects the final score.
- Reputo calculates a weighted average without decrypting the scores, then sends the final encrypted score to DeepID.

### Privacy and results
- Each child algorithm keeps its original DID type and result files.
- The details JSON contains the setup, observed score ranges, and run status. It does not contain plaintext user scores or encrypted values.

inputs.label: Child algorithms
inputs.description: Choose the algorithms to combine. Add each one only once, then set a weight above `0`. Higher weights have more effect on the final score.

outputs.label: Custom score details (JSON)
outputs.description: Setup, observed score ranges, and run status. This file does not contain plaintext user scores or encrypted values. Child result files remain separate.
